title: How to Activate 6sense and Folloze for Pipeline Orchestration
body_html:
What is the 6sense and Folloze Integration?

The integration between 6sense and Folloze is a no-code connection that transforms AI-powered intent signals into orchestrated, personalized buyer journeys. It combines 6sense's account identification, intent scoring, and buying stage data with Folloze's AI orchestration platform for campaign execution. This turns raw data into dynamic content experiences, sales actions, and measurable pipeline impact, moving beyond identification to activation.

Folloze acts as the operating system that makes 6sense data work. It answers the critical question: account selection tells you where to focus, but individual-level engagement tells you what to do next. This integration enables autonomous marketing with governance, allowing teams to launch campaigns 50% faster and prove revenue impact from prompt to pipeline.

Why Activate 6sense with Folloze?

Many B2B teams invest in intent data platforms like 6sense but struggle to activate that intelligence at scale. The data often sits in dashboards, disconnected from the systems that create buyer experiences. This leads to generic campaigns, slow response times, and an inability to prove how intent signals drive revenue.

Activating 6sense with Folloze solves this by creating a closed-loop system. 6sense provides the signal; Folloze provides the orchestration. The result is a measurable advantage: Folloze itself, using this integration, wins 84% of deals where it is the first vendor contacted and achieves high-quality account status for 88% of its target accounts.

The strategic outcome is clear pipeline orchestration. You can connect engagement directly to pipeline, as demonstrated by customers like Conga, which generated $6.3M in attributed pipeline from campaigns built on Folloze. This moves your program from reporting on intent to driving revenue with it.

How to Activate 6sense and Folloze in 5 Steps

Follow this process to move from integration to activation and pipeline impact.

Step 1: Establish Technical and Strategic Alignment

Begin by sharing your 6sense API key with your Folloze customer success manager. This no-code connection activates in under a minute. More importantly, align your marketing and sales teams on the goal. Define what a "high-intent" signal means for your business and agree on the orchestrated actions that should follow. This ensures the integration drives unified campaigns, not just more data.

Step 2: Map Intent Signals to Dynamic Content Journeys

With the integration live, 6sense intent, firmographic, and buying stage data flows into Folloze. Use Folloze's AI Campaign Agent to rapidly build targeted boards. For example, create a dynamic campaign for accounts in the "awareness" stage within a specific industry. The agent can generate relevant content themes, headlines, and structures in minutes, embodying the platform's promise of scaling programs without adding headcount. Populate these boards with content that addresses the specific needs indicated by the intent topics.

Step 3: Orchestrate Omni-Channel Activation

Do not limit activation to a single channel. Use Folloze to deploy 6sense-powered experiences across the buyer's journey. Launch intent-based digital ads that lead to personalized Folloze boards. Send tailored email nurtures that reflect the account's active research. Create dedicated sales rooms for high-propensity accounts, giving sales reps a live engagement dashboard. This omni-channel approach, powered by a single orchestration platform for ABM and demand gen, ensures consistent, relevant messaging wherever the buyer engages.

Step 4: Enable Sales with Real-Time Engagement Intelligence

Bridge the marketing-sales gap by sharing not just account scores, but individual-level behavior. Folloze captures deep engagement data who viewed what, for how long, and what content resonated. Combine this with 6sense's buying stage data in a shared sales room or dashboard. This tells a sales rep the account is in-market (6sense) and that the CFO spent 10 minutes on a pricing guide (Folloze), enabling a informed, timely conversation. This is the core of effective pipeline orchestration.

Step 5: Measure Impact and Optimize

Move beyond lead volume to revenue metrics. Use Folloze's attribution capabilities to tie engagement from 6sense-targeted campaigns directly to pipeline creation and influenced revenue. Analyze which intent topics, when activated through specific content journeys, drive the highest conversion rates. Use these insights to refine your signal-to-action playbooks. This focus on impact turns marketing into a revenue center, with clear proof like Microsoft's $10M influenced pipeline using Folloze.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Treating Integration as a Set-and-Forget Task: Connecting the API is just the start. The value comes from continuously building and optimizing the campaigns that the integration enables.
  • Activating Only at the Account Level: Buying decisions are made by people. Use the integration to drive personalized engagement for individuals within the buying committee, not just generic account messaging.
  • Ignoring Governance and Brand Safety: While speed is critical, bypassing review workflows can lead to off-brand or non-compliant messaging. Use Folloze's built-in approval chains to maintain quality while moving fast.
  • Failing to Close the Loop with Sales: If sales teams don't understand or trust the combined 6sense-Folloze intelligence, activation fails. Involve them in designing the sales enablement outputs and reporting.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How is this different from using 6sense with a website personalization tool?
A: Website tools are point solutions for a single channel. Folloze is an AI orchestration platform that activates 6sense data across omni-channel campaigns including ads, email, sales rooms, and event microsites. It also provides full revenue attribution and governance, which most personalization tools lack.

Q: Can we use this integration for unknown account targeting?
A: Yes. The integration uses the 6sense ID to enable targeting and personalization for both known and anonymous accounts across digital channels, allowing you to engage buying committees before they ever submit a form.

Q: How quickly can we launch a campaign after seeing an intent spike?
A> With Folloze's Campaign Agent, teams can build and launch targeted campaign boards in hours, not weeks. This speed is critical for capitalizing on timely intent signals. You can see this speed in action by requesting a demo.

Q: Does this require heavy IT or operations support?
A: No. The core integration is no-code and managed by Folloze. Campaign creation and orchestration are handled by marketing teams within the Folloze platform, reducing dependency on web or dev teams.

Conclusion: From Intent Signal to Pipeline Engine

Activating 6sense with Folloze transforms your intent data from a reporting asset into a pipeline engine. It closes the gap between signal and action by providing the AI orchestration layer to launch personalized buyer journeys at scale. The outcome is measurable: faster campaign velocity, deeper buying group engagement, and direct revenue impact. By following the steps outlined to align, map, orchestrate, enable, and measure, B2B go-to-market teams can finally execute on the full promise of intent data, moving from prompt to pipeline.
